segments.ja267:1.3: Tenābhibhūto kapaṇaṃ rudāmi, mā heva maṃ pāṇasamaṃ jaheyya [jaheyyā (pī.) jahā’ yye (?)].
segments.ja267:2.1: Ayya na taṃ jahissāmi, kuñjaraṃ saṭṭhihāyanaṃ [kuñjara saṭṭhihāyana (sī. pī.)];
segments.ja267:2.3: Pathabyā cāturantāya, suppiyo hosi me tuvaṃ.
segments.ja267:3.1: Ye kuḷīrā samuddasmiṃ, gaṅgāya yamunāya [nammadāya (sī. pī.)] ca;
segments.ja267:3.3: Tesaṃ tvaṃ vārijo seṭṭho, muñca rodantiyā patinti.
